title: Iterators and generators

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
Iterators and generators process large streams without loading everything into memory; exhausted generators must be recreated.
CORE EXPLANATION
A for loop consumes an iterable's iterator. yield defines a generator that produces values on demand.

spans.text: Mutating a collection while iterating can be surprising; build a new collection or iterate over a copy.
